d: Anant Singh Daughter Wedding: kya aapne kabhi aisi shadi dekhi hai...jahan dulha-dulhan se jyada charcha ghoron ki ho....jahan deshbhar ke nami ghore apni raphtar dikhane pahunch rahe hon....aur jahan jitne vale ghore ke malik ko inam men milegi chamachmati thar... ji han....bihar men mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi in dinon isi vajah se surkhiyon men hai...lekin is ghurdaur men ek aisa ghora bhi shamil hone ja raha hai, jis par sabki nigahen tiki hain...aakhir kaun hai ye ghora aur kya ye baki ghoron ko pachharkar thar apne nam kar paega...chalie batate hain puri…
